title: The World According to LLMs: How Geographic Origin Influences LLMs’ Entity Deduction Capabilities
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating geographic and cultural biases in Large Language Models using an entity deduction task (20 Questions). While it includes 'Religion' as a minor category for the 'Notable people' entities used in the benchmark, the paper's primary objective is to measure performance disparities across geographic regions (Global North/South/West/East) rather than to evaluate religion, faith traditions, or ethical frameworks themselves.
